title: Life-Logging Archive Integrity Score
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:ops archive_name=* integrity_passed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(integrity_passed="yes",1,0))) as matched by archive_name
| eval an_integrity_pass_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - an_integrity_pass_pct
description: Measures the percentage of archive validation checks that end with an integrity pass by archive.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which archive are helping or hurting archive validation checks.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `an integrity pass` on `memory:ops` events and summarize the hit rate by `archive_name`.
visualization: Table of archive with percentage of archive validation checks ending with an integrity pass.
grandmaExplanation: It builds how often an integrity pass happens for each archive so you can see where archive validation checks go smoothly or get stuck.
